metadata.classification: Consolidated operating model - client-confidential data protected
metadata.purpose: Operating data for KMT reporting, group planning, diligence, and intercompany analysis.
metadata.importantNote: Financial metrics are represented under a consolidated, authorized framework. Client identity details are omitted to maintain NDA compliance.
basisOfPreparation: Revenue is recognized on a simple accrual basis by calendar year.
2026 values are full-year forecasts based on signed work, active pipeline probability, and recurring run-rate assumptions as of 2026-07-13.
Client records utilize industry, country, value, status, and segment structures for reporting audits.
Intercompany transactions are recorded both as vendor spend for the buyer and service-line revenue for the seller unless marked as grant or capital.

groupProfile.name: Alien.Inc
groupProfile.description: A private operating group connecting capital allocation, consulting, cybersecurity, media, acquisitions, legal operations, and cultural preservation.
groupProfile.history: Alien.Inc was established on July 21, 1969, the day of the first moon landing. 1609 Holdings, the group's capital allocation arm, traces its origins to August 25, 1609. The Daily Art Cult and St. Alcantara Foundation joined the group as acquisitions, both originally established on May 18, 1926 — International Museum Day.
groupProfile.operatingThesis: 1609 Holdings allocates capital and governance capacity; KMT improves operations; Panteon controls digital risk; Exosphere sources opportunities; Statute & Precedent handles legal infrastructure; The Daily Art Cult builds cultural distribution; St. Alcantara Foundation anchors preservation and public-benefit work.
